mentions.name: Instagram-to-RSS feed tool
mentions.description: An extensible open-source tool that converts public Instagram accounts into RSS feeds, so users can follow Instagram content through RSS readers and quit the Instagram app entirely.
mentions.problem: Lets people keep up with Instagram content without using Instagram, so they can quit the app for good.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a n extensible OSS tool to turn public Instagram accounts into rss feeds so I can quit Instagram for good https://rss.numbersoffice.com.
mentions.author: maxibenner
